title: cephalaria albescens
intro: Cephalaria albescens, commonly known as White or Yellow Hempflower, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Cephalaria albescens include its use as a traditional remedy for fever reduction, pain relief, and wound healing, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
